name: dezzign
description: Redesign a client's existing website the ZekerZichtbaar way: crawl the old site, find a concept anchored in the client's own world, build the full sitemap, pick Osmo and Made With GSAP resources and design every page, phone boards and a states sheet on a Design canvas, then score the old site and the new design with a blind critic and export to Figma. The 'stramien' (page skeleton, section patterns and style directions distilled from the sites we build) and a Mobbin-sourced variant library are defaults the concept may break with a written reason, so runs do not converge on one layout. Concept, craft and critic methods adapted from juliobsz/skills (MIT).
